title: Correspondence
summary: Read synchronized email, messages, calls, and voicemail; link correspondence to to-dos or calendar events; and prepare unsent SMS handoffs.

resources.reason: JMAP, explicit Android synchronization, and explicit Google Messages for Web synchronization own correspondence creation and updates; the local consolidated view is readable but not independently editable.

resources.title: Correspondence to-do
resources.summary: A user-managed association between one correspondence item and one personal to-do.

update.reason: This edge has no mutable attributes; link and unlink are its complete lifecycle.

resources.title: Correspondence calendar event
resources.summary: A user-managed association between one correspondence item and one saved calendar event or recurring series.

update.reason: This edge has no mutable attributes; link and unlink are its complete lifecycle.

resources.title: Correspondence attachment
resources.summary: A provider-ingested file attached to one correspondence item.
resources.reason: Correspondence synchronization owns attachment identity and lifecycle.

resources.title: Correspondence participant
resources.summary: A provider-ingested participant identity retained with one correspondence item.
resources.reason: Correspondence synchronization owns participant roles, addresses, and contact-method evidence.

resources.title: Correspondence email mailbox
resources.summary: Provider-owned current membership between synchronized email correspondence and a JMAP mailbox.
resources.reason: JMAP synchronization owns mailbox membership; the local relationship is a readable mirror and cannot be edited independently.
